scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('public/bundle', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/compress-image.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=chrome55 --outfile=public/bundle/compress-image.js && esbuild src/app.js --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome55 --outfile=public/app.js
scripts.test: npm run build && esbuild src/image.ts src/duplicates.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=.test-build --out-extension:.js=.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
